Bookly Alternative for WordPress

Looking for a Bookly alternative? Roohsites Appointment Booking is a WordPress booking plugin with unlimited staff and services in its free version, and one Pro plan for payments, reminders and Google Calendar, without separate add-ons.

Checked on October 31, 2026 from each plugin's WordPress.org page and pricing page. Prices are regular (not sale) prices in US dollars. These plugins run sales often and change their plans, so check their sites before you buy.

Bookly's free version

Bookly's free version allows up to five services. Its WordPress.org page says online payments, unlimited staff and services, and add-ons are not available in the free version: they need the paid Bookly Pro add-on.

Roohsites Appointment Booking's free version has no staff or service limit, so a salon with five stylists or a tutoring centre with twenty classes can take bookings without paying. Online payments, reminders and calendar sync are in Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro.

Bookly pricing vs Roohsites Appointment Booking

Bookly: From $99 a year (Pro, 1 site), or $129 once for a lifetime licence. Yearly plans renew every year; a lifetime licence is paid once.

Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro: $79 a year for 1 site, $149 for 5 sites, $299 for unlimited. Same price every year: what you pay in year one is what you pay in year two.

Three years, one website (regular prices): Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro $237 (1 site); Bookly $297 (Pro, yearly) or $129 once (lifetime).

When Bookly is the better choice

Bookly has been around since 2014 and has one of the biggest feature sets of any WordPress booking plugin: events, packages, waiting lists, multiple locations and many payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, 2Checkout, Authorize.Net, Mollie and more). Its paid plans come in three tiers (Pro, Business and Ultimate), yearly or lifetime.

  • You want to pay once. Bookly sells lifetime licences. Over three years, its lifetime Pro licence ($129 at the regular price) costs less than a Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro subscription ($237).
  • You need its advanced extras. Waiting lists, packages, events and multiple locations are all part of Bookly's paid plans.
  • You need a payment gateway Roohsites Appointment Booking doesn't have. Bookly lists 2Checkout, Authorize.Net, Mollie, Payson, PayUbiz and PayU Latam. Roohsites Appointment Booking has Razorpay, Stripe and PayPal.

Why people choose Roohsites Appointment Booking instead

  • No staff or service limit for free. Bookly's free version allows up to five services and needs Bookly Pro for unlimited staff.
  • Razorpay and UPI. Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro takes UPI, cards, netbanking and wallets through Razorpay, as well as Stripe and PayPal.
  • WhatsApp and SMS reminders in Pro, through Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API and Twilio.
  • One plan, everything included. Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro has no add-ons to buy: payments, reminders, Google Calendar, the admin calendar, coupons and extras are all in it.
  • Customers reschedule themselves from a My bookings page, without creating an account.

What you get with Roohsites Appointment Booking

  • Free, with unlimited staff and services: a three-step booking form (Booking form block or [rsab_booking] shortcode), a calendar that only shows free times, email confirmations, a secure cancel link for customers, approval or auto-confirm, and WordPress's privacy tools for customer data requests.
  • Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro: online payments or deposits with Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets), Stripe or PayPal, confirmed instantly by webhook and refunded automatically when you cancel; reminders by email, SMS or WhatsApp; two-way Google Calendar sync for each staff member; a drag-and-drop admin calendar; a "My bookings" page where customers reschedule or cancel without an account; breaks and special dates; service extras, coupons, extra questions and branded emails.
  • Pricing: $79 a year for one site, $149 for five and $299 for unlimited. Renewals cost the same as your first year. 14-day free trial (no card) and a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you stop renewing, Pro keeps working; only updates and support stop.

How to switch from Bookly to Roohsites Appointment Booking

  1. Install the free Roohsites Appointment Booking plugin next to Bookly. They don't interfere with each other.
  2. Add your services (name, duration, price, buffer) and staff (photo, services, weekly hours, days off) under Roohsites Appointment Booking. Roohsites Appointment Booking doesn't import Bookly data, so this is done by hand; for most small businesses it takes 10 to 20 minutes.
  3. On your booking page, replace the Bookly form with the Booking form block, or the [rsab_booking] shortcode in a page builder.
  4. Keep Bookly active until its last upcoming bookings have passed, then deactivate it.
  5. Need payments, reminders or Google Calendar? Start the 14-day Pro trial and connect Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal under Roohsites Appointment Booking → Pro settings.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best free alternative to Bookly?

If you need more than five services or several staff on a free plan, Roohsites Appointment Booking's free version has no staff or service limit. LatePoint's free version is another option if you work alone and want free online payments.

Is Roohsites Appointment Booking cheaper than Bookly?

Yearly, yes: Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro is $79 a year for one site and Bookly Pro is $99 at its regular price. If you'd rather pay once, Bookly's lifetime Pro licence ($129) costs less over three years.

Does Roohsites Appointment Booking take Razorpay payments like Bookly?

Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro takes Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets), Stripe and PayPal. Razorpay isn't among the gateways listed on Bookly's WordPress.org page.

Can I move my bookings from Bookly to Roohsites Appointment Booking?

Roohsites Appointment Booking doesn't import Bookly data. Set up your services and staff in Roohsites Appointment Booking, swap the form on your booking page, and keep Bookly active until its upcoming bookings have passed.
